label: Period outfits
description: Historical garment combinations spanning eras and cultural regions.
notes: Complete historical looks; every entry carries an era tag, with region tags for specific dress traditions. Casual, smart, and formal own contemporary clothing, including living dress traditions; fantasy owns invented historical-looking costumes. These are visual wardrobe cues, not claims of museum-grade reconstruction. Garments never imply descent or body type. Cultural garments are available in any region. Use subject-appropriate pronouns. Picks require writer compatibility with the setting and activity. Palette roles colour dyed cloth; white, unbleached and metallic garments retain intrinsic colours. Muted, earthy and light schemes keep all allowed role colours suitable for period cloth. Status describes wardrobe means, with overlapping categories for shared garments; coverage describes garment extent.
